HELP / QUIZ RUN

Quiz Run Support

Quiz Run is an educational English-language runner game for Android, iPhone, and iPad.

Contact

For help, bug reports, or privacy questions, email quizrun.support@gmail.com.

When reporting a problem, include:

  • device model;
  • Android or iOS/iPadOS version;
  • Quiz Run version;
  • a short description of what happened;
  • a screenshot, if available.

Do not send passwords, payment information, or other sensitive personal information. Quiz Run does not use accounts and support will never ask for a password.

Local game data

Records and custom question packs are stored only on the device. Quiz Run does not provide cloud synchronization. Uninstalling the game may remove this local data, subject to device backup settings.
